channel.title: Crypto Front Page
channel.description: Crypto Front Page reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto industry.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin rewards open to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield directly but leaves exchange rewards for case-by-case review, keeping a disputed route open.

item.title: Why a Zero-Balance USDT Recipient Uses More Energy
item.description: A USDT transfer uses more Energy when the recipient’s token balance is zero: the contract must create a balance record, and the sender pays for that extra work.

item.title: Portal Bridge in four questions before you transfer
item.description: Portal bridge transfers depend on the route and token you select: check what leaves your wallet, what arrives, how it is claimed and which fees apply.

item.title: Solana sets Alpenglow consensus switch for Wednesday
item.description: Solana is set to activate Alpenglow on Wednesday, moving validator votes off-chain and targeting finality near 150 milliseconds for confirmed blocks.

item.title: chainslist in Five Steps: Add an EVM Network to Your Wallet
item.description: chainslist passes an EVM network’s chain ID and RPC settings to a wallet; five checks show how to find the right chain and confirm the connection.

item.title: Chainflip swaps: choosing a path for your integration
item.description: Chainflip integrations choose between a deposit address users fund later and a vault transaction they sign now; the right path follows the wallet flow and source chain.

item.title: Injective and BDACS plan KRW1 settlement for tokenized assets
item.description: Injective and BDACS signed an MOU to use KRW1 for tokenized-asset trading and settlement, adding a won-denominated route to onchain markets.

item.title: How Long Does an Across Bridge Transfer Take?
item.description: Most Across transfers deliver funds in about two seconds after the deposit is detected, while settlement and fallback fills follow a slower, separate process.

item.title: Mesh and Visa link wallet balances to card network
item.description: Mesh and Visa will let participating wallet users pay from crypto, stablecoin or fiat balances at Visa merchants, with Mesh managing transaction funding and conversion.

item.title: BlackRock’s IBIT Logs $665 Million Inflow on Oct. 19
item.description: BlackRock’s IBIT took in $665.16 million on Oct. 19, its biggest daily inflow since October 2025, lifting U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs to a $526.6 million net gain.

item.title: Ethereum schedules Glamsterdam upgrade for Hoodi on Oct. 26
item.description: Ethereum scheduled Glamsterdam for Hoodi on Oct. 26, setting a 200M gas limit as operators test new block-building and validation rules before any mainnet date.

item.title: EBA gives Circle’s USDC significant-token status in EU
item.description: The EBA classified Circle’s USDC as the EU’s first significant e-money token, shifting oversight of its reserves and liquidity to the EU regulator from Nov. 12.

item.title: Ledger Reviews Wallet Sales After $90 Million Crypto Theft
item.description: Ledger is reviewing how its hardware wallets reach buyers after hidden implants captured recovery phrases and enabled an estimated $90 million in crypto theft.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs Take In $5.1M as Ether Funds Shed $60.3M
item.description: US spot bitcoin funds drew $5.1 million on Oct. 15 while ether funds lost $60.3 million, a split measured through daily fund creations and redemptions.

item.title: When bridge funds become spendable on another chain
item.description: Bridge funds become spendable when the destination chain records a valid release, mint or relayer fill; the wait depends on the route’s settlement design.

item.title: How to Fund Cross-Chain Arbitrage With Existing Crypto
item.description: Cross-chain arbitrage can start with tokens you already hold, but funding depends on where they sit, when they arrive and whether the spread survives fees.

item.title: How to bridge crypto during a sharp market move
item.description: During a sharp move, check the route, final amount, fees, settlement path and destination gas before bridging; urgency can make a slow or thin route costly.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta pair stablecoins with card payments
item.description: Marqeta and Coinbase will let enterprise customers offer stablecoin-funded cards, pairing Coinbase custody and conversion with Base settlement and Marqeta processing.

item.title: What Wallet Swappers Should Check for Price Impact and Slippage
item.description: Price impact is built into a swap quote; slippage is the change before execution. Check both, plus minimum received, route, fees and network.

item.title: Estimate Wallet Changes Across Two Chains
item.description: Estimate cross-chain wallet change by rebuilding balances per chain, separating transfers from bridge flows, and checking which addresses can be linked with confidence.
